label.purpose: Accessible name of the top-bar Activity status.
label.where: Top bar, Activity status (screen-reader label of the status text; not shown).

idle.purpose: Says no background work is running.
idle.where: Top bar, Activity status when nothing runs; also the empty line in the opened Activity list.

task.scan.purpose: Names the scan job in the Activity status.
task.scan.where: Top bar, Activity status and Activity list rows, while the music folders are being scanned.

task.read.where: Top bar, Activity status and list rows, while tags and audio properties are read.

task.hash.where: Top bar, Activity status and list rows, while files are hashed.

task.fingerprint.where: Top bar, Activity status and list rows, while files are fingerprinted.

task.group.where: Top bar, Activity status and list rows, while duplicates are grouped.

task.analyze.purpose: Names the BPM and key analysis job.
task.analyze.where: Top bar, Activity status and list rows, while BPM and key are estimated.

task.embed.where: Top bar, Activity status and list rows, while the audio model runs.

task.convert.where: Top bar, Activity status and list rows, while files are converted.

task.export.where: Top bar, Activity status and list rows, while an export runs.

task.read_rekordbox.purpose: Names the job that reads the rekordbox export.
task.read_rekordbox.where: Top bar, Activity status and list rows, while a rekordbox XML export is read.

task.relink.purpose: Names the job that matches rekordbox tracks to files.
task.relink.where: Top bar, Activity status and list rows, after a rekordbox read, while tracks are matched to files.

task.attach.purpose: Names the job that adds rekordbox data to tracks.
task.attach.where: Top bar, Activity status and list rows, after matching, while rekordbox data is attached to tracks.

percent.purpose: A task name with its progress.
percent.where: Top bar, Activity status and list rows, for a running job that reports progress ({{task}} is a task name above).

andMore_one.purpose: Adds how many other jobs there are (one).
andMore_one.where: Top bar, Activity status, after the lead job, when exactly one other job is running or queued.

andMore_other.purpose: Adds how many other jobs there are (several).
andMore_other.where: Top bar, Activity status, after the lead job, when several other jobs are running or queued.

waiting_one.purpose: Says one job is queued and none is running.
waiting_one.where: Top bar, Activity status, when nothing runs but one job waits.

waiting_other.purpose: Says several jobs are queued and none is running.
waiting_other.where: Top bar, Activity status, when nothing runs but several jobs wait.

queued.purpose: Marks a job that hasn't started.
queued.where: Activity list, a row for a queued job.

stopping.purpose: Marks a job that was cancelled and is winding down.
stopping.where: Activity list, a row after its Cancel was clicked and the job hasn't ended yet.

cancel.where: Activity list, on every job row.
